title: Busy accounts stay fast
summary: Every update to Trillion is now tried on an account as busy as the busiest real one before it reaches you.

payload.title: Busy accounts stay fast
payload.body: Before any update to Trillion goes out, it now runs against an account with hundreds of AIs, thousands of open jobs and a long payment history. An update that would make such an account read everything again on each request is stopped, so yours stays quick as it grows.
